resources.string: Showing subtitles over the TV\'s HDMI picture
Overlay turned off: subtitles now show inside CouchSubs. Press OK for the panel.
Overlay mode: subtitles appear over the TV\'s own HDMI picture.
No picture inside CouchSubs. Switching to overlay mode: subtitles appear over the TV\'s own HDMI picture.
Switch the TV to the PS5\'s input (HDMI %1$d) with the remote. Subtitles will appear on top.
Overlay mode needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission.
The PS5 picture is not coming through inside CouchSubs. On some TVs it stays black here; overlay mode fixes this, but it needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission.

Overlay is selected, but this TV app from Google Play has no overlay mode, so subtitles are shown inside CouchSubs. Overlay is in the version that CouchSubs on your computer installs directly on the TV: uninstall this copy, turn on USB debugging on the TV and start the translation on your computer.

CouchSubs on your computer grants it when it installs the TV app: start the translation there with USB debugging on. Or on the TV open Settings › Apps › Special app access › Display over other apps and turn on CouchSubs.
CouchSubs could not tell which HDMI input your console is on. Switch the TV to it with the remote; subtitles will appear on top.
CouchSubs could not tell which HDMI input your console is on.
No picture from HDMI %1$d.
No device on HDMI %1$d.
Choose the HDMI input your PS5 is connected to (arrow keys and OK, or number keys 1–4):

Still black on the right input? This TV may not hand its HDMI picture to apps (some Vestel and MediaTek TVs), or HDCP blocks it. Try turning off Settings › System › HDMI › Enable HDCP on the PS5. Otherwise switch the TV to the PS5\'s HDMI input with the remote and read the subtitles on your phone.
This TV does not let apps show its HDMI inputs, so the PS5 picture cannot appear inside CouchSubs. Switch the TV to the PS5\'s HDMI input with the remote and read the subtitles on your phone.
This Google Play version has no overlay mode. The TV app installed by CouchSubs on a computer has it: subtitles appear over the TV\'s own HDMI picture.
connected
Close
Or switch to overlay: the TV shows the PS5 on its own HDMI input and the subtitles appear on top.
Switch to overlay

Overlay is on and CouchSubs keeps running in the background. This TV does not let apps change its input: switch the TV to the PS5\'s HDMI input with the remote, and subtitles appear on top. If they do not show on the HDMI input, this device draws HDMI outside Android (some projectors) and no app can draw over it: read the subtitles on your phone. Open CouchSubs again to turn the overlay off.
Overlay could not start: this TV did not let CouchSubs show subtitles over other apps. CouchSubs stays open; you can read the subtitles on your phone.
The subtitle page was closed by this TV\'s web view (Android System WebView) several times in a row. Restart the TV and try again; until then you can read the subtitles on your phone.
